shipReasons: Bailey's first report is fixed in both games: on live every FFX-2 single-any offensive row (Power/Armor/Magic/Mental Break, Drain, Confuse, Break, Doom, Death, Dispel, Cheap Shot) opened on Yuna; on the candidate each opens on an enemy in chapters 4, 5 and 6, driven with real keys.

No regression against live: the live-vs-candidate sweep of every enabled command row over 4 decisions per chapter in chapters 1, 2, 3, 8, 4, 5 and 6 differs ONLY in the intended rows (the offensive single-any rows above, and Phoenix Down now opening on a KO'd ally). Cures, buffs, Esuna, Regen, Reflect, self rows, ALL ALLIES / ALL ENEMIES chips, Attack and every single-enemy row open exactly where they did live.

The left-to-right arrow walk is kept: Right and Left visit every legal candidate and wrap, in the same screen cycle as live, on single-any rows in all seven chapters; a mouse click on a bracket and Enter both commit the attack to the aimed target (action-start + damage on that id).

The FFX-2 Wait default is unchanged against live: in chapters 4, 5 and 6 the clock holds at the top list, in a submenu and at the target cursor, the previous girl's skill does not resolve under the next girl's menu, and Esc pause/resume keeps Wait; live measures the same. Active runs everywhere on both builds.

The switched-off split (?wait=split) works as designed: the clock runs at the top list and the previous girl's skill resolves while the next girl's list is open (chapters 4, 5, 6), holds in a submenu and at the target cursor, resumes on Esc back to the top, and survives a pause. A real-key fight in chapter 4 under ?wait=split ran 53 turns to its outcome and results screen with no lock.
No critical defect: zero page errors in every candidate run; FFX chapter 1 and FFX-2 chapter 6 reach victory and the results screen, and a real Enter leaves it with the chapter outcome resolved.

One major is disclosed, not held: Bailey's second report (Wait holds everything until all three girls have chosen) is still the default because the faithful split ships switched off pending his ruling; identical on live (DC2-01).

issues.title: FFX-2 Wait still holds every action until all three girls have chosen: Bailey's second report is not fixed by default

issues.observed: Default (no URL switch) and ?wait=hold: ticks stay frozen at the next girl's top list for 6-9 s and the previous girl's skill does not resolve until the menu is answered, exactly as on live. The faithful split exists and works behind ?wait=split.
issues.repro: Chapter 4, answer the first girl with a Skill, leave the next girl on her top list: nothing moves (wait-cand.json, default and hold runs).
issues.confidence: high: measured in three chapters on both builds
issues.fix: Bailey rules on D-029 follow-up 2; if he picks the split, flip DEFAULT_WAIT_SPLIT.
issues.acceptanceCheck: With no URL switch, a chosen skill resolves while the next girl's top list is open, and ticks hold in a submenu and at the target cursor, in chapters 4-6.

issues.observed: aim.ts classes Reflect and Regen as helpful and opens them on a party member (Wakka in ch8, Yuna in ch5). Same opening as live (leftmost party member), so not a regression; the arrows still reach Evrae.
issues.fix: Ask Bailey whether the convention stands; optionally open on the advisor's named target when it names one.

issues.title: FFX-2 flower reticle on Vegnagun is drawn over the intent panel and the command menu at 1600x900 (pre-existing)

issues.fix: Cap the flower radius to the part's projected rect and keep it off the registered HUD panels, as the plate already does.
issues.acceptanceCheck: Chapter 5 Attack at 1600x900 and 2000x1012: no flower petal intersects .ffx2hud__command or the intent panel.

issues.title: Under ?wait=split nothing on screen says the clock is running at the top list
issues.expected: research/ffx2-combat-core.md mode-indicator row: the indicator alternates between Active mode and Wait mode in real time.
issues.observed: The ATB chip is hidden at the top list and shows "WAIT — ATB HELD" only at the target cursor; with the split on, the clock runs at the top list with no indicator.
issues.repro: Chapter 4 with ?wait=split, stay on the top list.
issues.fix: If Bailey keeps the split, show the chip at the top list too (WAIT — ATB RUNNING).
